title: D2P Fit Evaluation Report
description: Derived document: the fit evaluation of one pattern evaluation against pinned fit-profile and garment-measurement-spec revisions. It is evidence, never an authoritative artifact, and it never claims a guaranteed fit. It distinguishes analytical results, simulation results and real fitting observations.
$comment: Schema catalog section 3.3 (design decision ADR-011 sections 2 and 7). resultDigest per digest profile d2p-digest-v1, excluding contentDigest, resultDigest, reportId and createdAt. Array order: inputDigests per catalog section 1.8, results by id, diagnostics per catalog section 1.8. Mandatory inputDigests roles (pattern, fit-profile, garment-measurement-spec) and evaluationRef.digest are required by this schema.

schemaVersion.description: Full SemVer of the standard release this document was written against.

createdAt.description: UTC time the report was produced. Excluded from resultDigest.

evaluationRef.description: Reference to the pattern-evaluation document this report evaluates. digest is required and holds that evaluation's resultDigest.

evaluator.description: The evaluator that produced the report (engine, versions, evaluator profile, optional precision).

inputDigests.description: Digests of all pinned inputs. Roles 'pattern', 'fit-profile' and 'garment-measurement-spec' are mandatory.

evidenceKind.description: Kind of evidence: 'analytical' (computed from evaluated geometry), 'simulation' (3D simulation), 'fitting-observation' (a real fitting). Kinds are never mixed in one report.

results.description: One result per evaluated garment measurement, sorted by id.

containsPersonalData.description: True if the report contains values derived from an artifact classified 'personal' or 'sensitive-personal' (e.g. a body measurement profile of an individual).

diagnostics.description: Diagnostics raised while evaluating fit (may be empty, then written as []). Messages and details MUST NOT contain raw personal measurement values.

resultDigest.description: Digest of the report per digest profile d2p-digest-v1, excluding contentDigest, resultDigest, reportId and createdAt.

contentDigest.description: Optional digest of this document per digest profile d2p-digest-v1 (excluding contentDigest itself).

fitResult.title: Fit result
fitResult.description: Predicted value of one garment measurement, compared with its target where one applies.

id.description: Element ID of the result, unique within the report.

garmentDefinitionId.description: Garment measurement definition of the result (informative, not resolved by the referential level).

predicted.description: Predicted (or, for fitting observations, observed) value of the garment measurement.

target.description: Target value the prediction is compared with. Absent when no target applies.

deviation.description: predicted − target. Absent when no target applies.

status.description: 'within-tolerance', 'outside-tolerance', or 'not-evaluated' (no target, tolerance or evidence available). Never a fit guarantee.
